links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT-4o responses on pediatric urolithiasis relative to patient comprehension
links.effect: FRE 27.98, FKGL 11.46, SMOG 14.96; only 2.5% understandable at 10-12-year-old level, 37.5% college level, 60% professional level
links.quote: Only 2.5% of responses were understandable to individuals with reading skills at a 10-12-year-old level, 37.5% were suitable for college-level readers, and 60% required professional-level comprehension.

screen.reason: Evaluates the quality, reliability, and readability of ChatGPT-4o responses to pediatric urolithiasis FAQs without testing an organizational deployment safeguard or practice.
